title: Accessibility of infinity-categorical pullbacks
statement: Use the infinity-category, smallness, accessibility, and presentability conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. A functor is accessible when it preserves $\kappa$-filtered colimits for some regular cardinal $\kappa$. If $\mathcal A\to\mathcal C\leftarrow\mathcal B$ is a pair of accessible functors between accessible infinity categories, its homotopy pullback $\mathcal A\times_{\mathcal C}\mathcal B$ is accessible. The infinity category $\mathcal S$ of small spaces is presentable. Every presentable infinity category admits all small limits as well as all small colimits.
